notices.title: Diwali vacation and hostel maintenance
notices.text:
SAMPLE INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
HOSTEL ADMINISTRATION
Circular No. HA/2026-27/09                                   Date: 08 October 2026

Subject: Diwali vacation, hostel closure, maintenance work and rules for residents staying back

Dear Residents,

This circular contains important information regarding the upcoming Diwali vacation and the annual maintenance of hostel buildings. All residents are requested to read it carefully and follow the instructions.

A. Vacation and closure
1. The institute will remain closed for Diwali vacation from 30 October 2026 to 8 November 2026 (both days inclusive). Classes will resume on 9 November 2026.
2. Hostel Blocks C and D will be completely closed from 31 October 2026 (12:00 noon) to 7 November 2026 for electrical rewiring and painting. Residents of Blocks C and D must vacate their rooms by 11:00 AM on 31 October 2026.
3. Blocks A and B will remain open for residents who need to stay back.

B. Residents staying back
4. Residents who wish to stay in the hostel during the vacation must fill the stay-back form on the student portal by 22 October 2026. Requests after this date will not be considered.
5. Stay-back residents from Blocks C and D will be shifted temporarily to Block B. Room allotment lists will be displayed on 28 October 2026.
6. Only the Block A mess will function during the vacation, with limited timings: breakfast 8:00–9:00 AM, lunch 12:30–1:30 PM, dinner 7:30–8:30 PM.
7. Stay-back residents must carry their hostel ID card at all times. Night attendance will be taken at 10:00 PM.

C. Before leaving
8. Residents going home must switch off and unplug all electrical appliances, lock their almirahs, and remove all food items from their rooms.
9. Valuables such as laptops and jewellery should not be left in the rooms. The hostel administration will not be responsible for any loss.
10. Residents of Blocks C and D must pack personal belongings into their almirahs or take them home so that painting can be carried out. Items left on the floor may be moved by the maintenance team.
11. Every resident must submit a leave form, signed by their parent or guardian, at the hostel office before leaving. Residents leaving without a leave form will be marked absent.

D. Maintenance requests
12. Residents who have pending maintenance complaints (fans, lights, taps, furniture) should register them on the hostel maintenance portal by 25 October 2026 so that they can be fixed during the closure.

E. Return
13. Hostel Blocks C and D will reopen at 10:00 AM on 8 November 2026. Residents must report to their warden on arrival.
14. Any damage noticed in the room on return must be reported in writing within 48 hours of reopening.

Residents are requested to cooperate with the hostel staff. For any queries, contact your block warden during office hours.

Wishing you a safe and happy Diwali.

Warden-in-Charge, Hostel Administration

SAMPLE INSTITUTE NOTICE
Examination Office
Date: 09 October 2026

SUBJECT: Mid-Semester Examinations for 1st Year (Odd Semester 2026-27)

1. Mid-semester examinations for all 1st year sections will be held from 2 November 2026 to 6 November 2026. The subject-wise schedule is available in the Exam Schedule section.
2. Admit cards can be downloaded from the student portal between 26 October 2026 and 31 October 2026.
3. Students with attendance below 75% as on 24 October 2026 will not be issued admit cards. Condonation requests with valid documents must reach the Head of Department by 26 October 2026.
4. Students must carry their admit card and college ID card. Mobile phones, smart watches and programmable calculators are not allowed.

notices.title: Mid-semester exam schedule – Semester III
notices.text:
SAMPLE INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
Office of the Controller of Examinations
Date: 05 October 2026

SUBJECT: Schedule of Mid-Semester Examinations and related activities – B.Tech Semester III

1. Mid-semester examinations for B.Tech Semester III will be held from 27 October 2026 to 3 November 2026 in two shifts: 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM and 2:00 PM – 3:30 PM.
2. The subject-wise date sheet will be displayed on the department notice boards and the student portal by 15 October 2026.
3. Students must download their admit cards from the student portal between 20 October 2026 and 25 October 2026. No student will be allowed into the examination hall without a printed admit card and college ID card.
4. Students with attendance below 75% as on 18 October 2026 will not be issued admit cards. Such students may submit a condonation request with valid medical documents to their Head of Department by 19 October 2026.
5. Lab record books must be submitted to the respective lab in-charge by 24 October 2026.
6. Mobile phones, smart watches and programmable calculators are strictly prohibited in the examination hall.

Controller of Examinations
